intent: Symbolic-AI research dossier only: bounded finite propositional abductive explanations; not selected D10 meaning, not runtime semantics, and not owner ratification.

proposal.law: For a finite ground propositional Horn theory T, designated abducibles A, observation g and finite integrity constraints IC, return the canonical antichain of inclusion-minimal Δ ⊆ A such that g belongs to the least fixed-point closure of T ∪ Δ and no integrity constraint is fully satisfied by that closure.

finite_fragment.theory: finite ground definite-Horn clauses over propositional atoms
finite_fragment.abducibles: finite designated set of atoms; only these may be hypothesized
finite_fragment.integrity_constraints: finite forbidden conjunctions; a candidate is inconsistent if every atom in one forbidden conjunction belongs to the closure
finite_fragment.entailment: least fixed-point closure under the ground Horn rules
finite_fragment.minimality: set-inclusion minimality among coherent explanations, not minimum cardinality alone
finite_fragment.output_order: each explanation has unique sorted atoms; explanations sort by ascending cardinality then lexicographic atom sequence

answer_distinctions.warning: No explanation is not the same as a successful proof requiring zero assumptions.

proposal.positive_witness: wet_shoes follows from either rain or sprinkler, so the complete minimal explanation family is [[rain],[sprinkler]].
falsifiers: Returning both rain and sprinkler as one required set is wrong when either alone proves wet_shoes.
Returning a superset such as [rain,sprinkler] is wrong when a proper subset already explains the observation.
Hypothesizing an atom outside the designated abducible set is forbidden.
A forbidden conjunction reached through derived facts must reject that candidate even when the forbidden atom was not explicitly hypothesized.
A mutually recursive Horn cycle without a seed must not prove itself.
A successful empty explanation [[]] must remain distinct from no explanations [].
proposal.behavioral_dedup: PENDING: current inventory exact-name and lower-domain check are automated; a human must still evaluate derivability via existing proof enumeration, integrity checks, and finite set algebra.

sources.title: Abductive Logic Programming
sources.publication: Journal of Logic and Computation 2(6), pp. 719–770 (1992)
sources.source_use: Section 1.1 defines explanation against a background theory and observation and requires consistency; the paper treats abduction as a family with explicit restrictions and multiple possible explanations.

sources.title: Abduction in logic programming: A new definition and an abductive procedure based on rewriting
sources.source_use: Addresses minimal explanations and avoiding subsumed explanations; this dossier deliberately specifies a smaller finite propositional fragment.

oracle.independent_runtime: SWI-Prolog, installed in the dedicated workflow

application_motivations_not_semantic_aut: A Viber or command-line assistant without an LLM could surface explicitly supported alternative assumptions rather than inventing a narrative answer.
Prolog, Datalog, CLIPS and Advice-Taker-style knowledge programs can use the same finite explanation contract while retaining their own rule-engine mechanisms.
Constraint-heavy Panini/grammar work can ask which explicit properties would make one analysis consistent, subject to an abducible vocabulary.
All applications are motivation only; no messaging, network, grammar, hardware or host operation is admitted by this dossier.

source_ranges.observable_contract: prove/accumulate results for a goal using extant rules
prove multiple goals against current knowledge/rule state
construct/display a proof tree for an obtained proof

repository_boundary_audit.contrast_to_candidate: The candidate explicitly enumerates subsets of a finite designated abducible set, evaluates least-fixed-point Horn closure, rejects integrity constraints over derived closure, and returns all subset-minimal coherent explanations.
repository_boundary_audit.unresolved_question: Can the full behavior be expressed as a library composition of existing proof, finite-set enumeration, and constraint checking? These source ranges establish a pinned comparison baseline; they do not prove a new Core identity.

atms_reduction_audit.relation: Not the same primitive: ATMS label join combines two support families under nogoods. In the bounded positive Horn fragment, iterating such support joins over rule bodies, propagating to a least fixed point, and filtering the goal antichain yields the same answers as enumerating allowed assumptions and checking closure/constraints.
comparison: Powerset enumeration + least-fixed-point closure + integrity-constraint checks
ATMS-style minimal support-label propagation + derived nogood antichain + goal-label filtering
atms_reduction_audit.exhaustive_domain: 3 propositional atoms; 0..2 definite-Horn rules chosen from all heads and bodies of size 0..2; all 8 abducible sets; 3 fact sets; no constraint, unary a nogood, or {a,b} nogood.
atms_reduction_audit.expected_outcome: bounded independent agreement strengthens the library-derivation hypothesis; keep HOLD pending owner/core review
caveats: This is finite-model equivalence only, not a proof for unbounded or first-order ALP.
This is not a SENS runtime oracle.
ATMS-CONSISTENT-LABEL-JOIN alone is not the full Horn label-propagation engine.
